correctness.rationale: For the single contracted Park–Shin neighborhood of hyperelliptic curve C:z²=x⁷−1, p infinity, A=O(p), k=2, extension class [t^(−5)], the package computes J1=0, J2=span(xT²), Jj=H0(C,A^j)T^j for j>=3 using the cited analytic filtration results. Pole semigroup <2,7> gives monomial bases. Seven parity-pure lifts have leading terms xT²,T³,xT³,T⁴,xT⁴,T⁵,zT⁷. Expansions of f2f4−f3g3 and f2f5−f3g4 cancel their first terms and give respectively +zT8 and +2zT9. These nine initials generate every Jj by semigroup induction (independent 5780 basis monomials checked for 3<=j<=109). The cited complete filtered-algebra lifting theorem then supplies seven formal generators. For lower bound, degree 2 gives one cotangent class, degree3 two, degree4 two, degree5 one; zT7 survives because direct degree7 products are polynomial in x and J2⊗J3→J5 is injective, preventing a lower-order cancellation from exposing z. Thus edim=7 under the named analytic lemmas. The Park–Shin preprint full text was inaccessible, so applicability of its precise filtration/lifting lemmas is retained as an explicit source-dependence risk; the package proof is conditional on these established lemmas, not on finite computation.
